name: Adipocyte
failures: Hypertrophic dysfunction, ectopic deposition, lipodystrophy, inflammatory secretion.

see.note: MRI and DEXA quantify fat depots precisely and non-invasively.

model.note: Healthy adiposity varies enormously between individuals.

reach.note: Accessible by volume but not specifically targetable.

edit.note: Incretin drugs change mass by changing behaviour and metabolism, not by editing cells.

verify.note: Mass and distribution are easy to measure.

anchors: GLP-1 agonists act systemically, not on the adipocyte directly
